title: R3.0C Capability Ledger
note: Defines each capability the Integrated Delivery Train may eventually enable, its kind, and the earliest checkpoint at which it may be unlocked. A capability being DEFINED here does NOT mean it is ENABLED. Enablement is governed by governance/r3.0c/state.json (enabledCapabilities). C0 only defines the universe; no production capability is enabled at C0.

contract_foundation_present.description: R3.0C CP1 comparison contracts present under contracts/r3.0c/. NON-PRODUCTION at C0: no rendererAdapter, no runtime consumer, no algorithm.

governance_bootstrap_present.description: R3.0C Integrated Delivery Governance scaffold present: schema, state, capabilities, checkpoint-manifest schema, three fail-closed validators, and trusted-verification integration.

production_adapter_present.description: Renderer-level adapter that exposes the contract surface to production code. Adds no algorithm; just plumbs the contract through a single authorized renderer/js module.

lap_authority_present.description: Authority that decides whether a lap is valid for comparison (drives reasonCodes from valid-lap-contract).

track_identity_authoritative.description: Track-identity equality decision; gates comparison eligibility across laps from different sessions.

comparison_export_present.description: Comparison export schema implementation honouring comparison-export-contract.

ui_present.description: Comparison UI surface in renderer/index.html and supporting renderer/js modules.

feature_registry_active.description: Feature Registry flips the deferred R3.0C feature IDs (case_comparison, reference_lap, corner_delta) to available, attaching their rendererAdapter. Only valid at C8.
